purpose: Primary DSpark arms (docs/speculative-decoding.md step 3): fixed vs adaptive verification, both checkpoints
runtime: vLLM 0.30.1rc1.dev223+g44af287eb (~/vllm), unchanged from the speculation-off arms
server: bench/serve.sh; same TP8+EP, 0.90 memory, max-model-len 262144, max-num-seqs 64, prefix caching OFF
workload: run_matrix.py --workloads concurrency --conc-list 1,4,16,64 --repeats 3: random 16384 in / 256 out, ignore_eos, temperature 0, thinking=false, n=max(16,4c), same seeds as the ar concurrency points; warmup c1/16/64 disjoint seeds
runs: 2 models x 2 arms x 4 loads x 3 repeats = 48
ar_baseline_reuse: Reuse existing ar concurrency points (v41 config off; 0731 config off-profidle, idle profiler shown equivalent on V4.1). Identical workload, seeds, sampling, prefix-cache-off, runtime; only speculative config differs.
validity: unchanged: all requests complete, output = n x 256, server prompt tokens >= 98% target
telemetry_added: spec_decode num_drafts / num_draft_tokens (scheduled = proposed) / num_accepted_tokens deltas; per-position acceptance recoverable from saved metrics_{before,after}.prom. Verified-candidate count under adaptive verification is not exported by this build: report as unavailable.
correctness: Post hoc: compare generated texts (--save-detailed) with the matching ar run, same prompts, greedy target; report mismatch rate, not a losslessness proof.
caveats: Random-token prompts: acceptance is workload-specific and not representative of real text; real-text sets (step 4) are out of scope for this pass.
Probabilistic draft sampling with a greedy target, per the doc fragment; greedy-draft is a separate arm.
